subject: general
question:
The marks scored by 10 students are given below.

10, 13, 17, 11, 11, 13, 14, 16, 13, 13

The mode of the data is:
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Mode** is the value that appears most frequently in a data set.

Given data: 10, 13, 17, 11, 11, 13, 14, 16, 13, 13

Counting the occurrences: 10 (1), 11 (2), 13 (4), 14 (1), 16 (1), 17 (1).

The number **13** occurs **4 times**, which is the maximum frequency.

**∴ The correct answer is 13.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Marks of 10 students = 10, 13, 17, 11, 11, 13, 14, 16, 13, 13

**Formula:** Mode = Value with the **maximum frequency**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a98fdc97d555777a61137fd40bb057dd94286700374ca9477a8880a02dabb19.png] 

Arranging the data in **ascending order** to count frequencies:

10, 11, 11, 13, 13, 13, 13, 14
